Package dev.opencollab.paletter.item

Class CustomItem

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.item.CustomItem
public final class CustomItem extends Object
A custom (data driven) item: an add-on JSON minecraft:item in Java. The palette assigns its runtime id and canonical id, compiles its components to the item component data of each palette's protocol, and places it in the creative inventory. 

 CustomItem ruby = CustomItem.builder("example:ruby")
     .component(Icon.of("ruby"))
     .component(MaxStackSize.of(16))
     .component(Durability.builder().maxDurability(250).build())
     .menuCategory(CreativeCategory.ITEMS, "itemGroup.name.minerals")
     .build();

An instance owns its type(): the palette hands back that same type and its base variant for the item, so they can be compared with ==. Other variants, given canonical ids with a layer's variant, are equal, not identical. Equal items (same identifier and definition) are equals, but each has a type of its own, see type().

Since:
1.0.0

    • type

      public @NonNull BedrockItemType type()
      The type of the item, to use it like a vanilla BedrockItems constant. It is created with the item and belongs to it: every call returns the same type (and the same base variant), and a palette the item is registered in hands back exactly these for it (decode, resolve, RegisteredItem.key(), ...), so == works like for vanilla constants. Another, equal item has a type of its own, equal to this one but not identical: a palette hands back the type of the instance its layer registered.
      Returns:
      the type of the item
      Since:
      1.0.0
